temperature_action.instructions: Choose the complete temperature action requested by query. A setpoint and its unit are one action. Preserve the requested scale and number; never convert or approximate. Frost-protection heating and demand-response offset are not target temperatures. If the requested setpoint is outside the supported range, choose omit. Unit-only candidates apply only to an explicit unit-only change.
